items.q: The liquor was held by (what was his name?) Socks Brownstein(?)...the owner of the drugstore across the street from it...

ctx.x: But he was sort of a stockholder, because he was the only one that knew how to run it. But they didn't have any liquor there. The liquor was held by (what was his name?) Socks Brownstein(?)...the owner of the drugstore across the street from it... What was his name? He was the one that prevented the Savoy from getting a liquor license. For years Brownstein...Sapir...not Sapirstein... Sapirstein was then the head of...the Alcohol Lord of New York State -- later they put him out of the way. Not the head of the…
Well, when I first went there in 1937 they had sherry, they had wine, but they didn't have liquor.
